clue.text: US city is behind new online map

indicators.note: behind places the word is after the rearranged letters
new says the letters of online map are made into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A cartographer's note that some American city appears behind a freshly published web map.
explanation.definitionFit: Minnesota's largest city, twin to St Paul, is an example of a US city.

clue.text: A student hugged by girl — that's infectious

indicators.note: hugged by says the first pieces sit wrapped inside the girl's name

parts.note: Maria is a girl's name
taken as written
L is a learner, the plate on a UK learner driver's car

explanation.surface: A student embraced by a girl is warned that something is catching.
explanation.definitionFit: The disease spread by mosquito bites is a classic infection, so it fits a description of what is infectious.

clue.text: Spice in stone cask brought up

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a gem is a precious stone
a tun is a large beer or wine cask

explanation.surface: A spice is found in a stone barrel hauled up from a cellar.
explanation.definitionFit: The seed of an Indonesian tree, grated over custards and eggnog, is a familiar kitchen spice.

clue.text: I sent a side to play in Borneo etc

indicators.note: to play suggests the letters are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: A cricket captain says he dispatched a team to compete in Borneo and nearby places.
explanation.definitionFit: The old name for the islands of the Malay Archipelago, including Borneo, Java and Sumatra.

clue.text: Cat rising in the morning, out of bed

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the letters go upwards, read backwards

parts.note: AM is ante meridiem, before noon
up means out of bed

explanation.surface: A cat getting up early in the morning, leaving its bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The cougar or mountain lion of the Americas is a large wild cat.

clue.text: Hang about, that is intimate stuff

parts.note: to linger is to hang about
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone says 'Wait a minute, that's private' about something personal.
explanation.definitionFit: Women's underwear is known as intimate apparel, the stuff worn next to the skin.

clue.text: Cult I connected to area

parts.note: a sect is a cult or religious faction
taken as written
on means switched on, connected

explanation.surface: A cult member says they have joined up with a particular district.
explanation.definitionFit: A portion or part of something, such as a zone of a city, is a section.

clue.text: In error, Greek character backing exercise system

indicators.note: backing means the whole assembly is read backwards
In says the Greek letter is placed within the word for error

parts.note: a slip is a small error
eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone mistakenly thinks a Greek figure is endorsing a fitness regime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Error' looks like part of the surface's 'in error', but 'In' is the insertion signal and 'backing' reverses the whole assembly, not just the Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Joseph Pilates devised the core-strengthening fitness method named after him, an exercise system.

clue.text: George of England perhaps, unlikely star in panto

indicators.note: unlikely suggests an improbable rearrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: St George as an improbable lead in a Christmas pantomime, the British family stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: St George is the holy protector of England, its guardian figure in the church calendar.

clue.text: Threatened people defeated by first shot

parts.note: men means people
in tennis, a player aced is beaten by a serve, the first shot

explanation.surface: A group of people felt threatened after losing to an opening blow.
explanation.definitionFit: To be menaced is to be intimidated or put in danger, a synonym of threatened.

clue.text: Platform for workers teaching doctor

parts.note: drilling is teaching by repetition
to rig is to doctor or falsify

explanation.surface: A medical teacher is giving a podium to staff.
explanation.definitionFit: An offshore oil installation is a structure where crews of workers live and bore for oil.

clue.text: Starter in Rajasthan filling belly; boy, it's hot!

indicators.note: filling says that letter goes inside the word for belly

parts.note: tum is an informal word for belly

indicators.note: Starter in picks the opening letter of Rajasthan

parts.note: Eric is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A boy eating an Indian starter in Rajasthan finds it fiery.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow spice used in curries is warm and pungent, so it is something that is hot in flavour.

clue.text: Twins placing car behind empty garage

indicators.note: behind places the car's name after the emptied garage
empty means the garage loses its inside letters, leaving its outer ones

parts.note: the Mini is a classic small British car

explanation.surface: Someone parks a car behind a cleared-out garage.
explanation.definitionFit: The zodiac sign of Castor and Pollux is called the Twins in astrology.

clue.text: Appalling wind finally is blowing

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of wind

parts.note: taken as written
gusting means blowing in strong bursts

explanation.surface: A weather report complains that a dreadful gale is at last blowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something appalling is revolting or shocking, a sense also carried by sickening.

clue.text: Country lady needing no introduction

indicators.note: needing no introduction means the word for lady loses its opening letter

parts.note: a lady is a woman

explanation.surface: A woman from some country is so famous she needs no introduction.
explanation.definitionFit: The sultanate on the south-east of the Arabian Peninsula is a country.

clue.text: Extra odd Italian forms

indicators.note: forms says the letters are shaped into a new word

explanation.surface: An unusual Italian fills in some extra paperwork.
explanation.definitionFit: Additional means further or supplementary, a synonym of extra.

clue.text: One creating a stir in the cup?

definitions.text: One creating a stir in the cup?

parts.words: One creating a stir in the cup?
parts.note: a stir sounds like a fuss or scandal, perhaps at a cup final, but it is literal stirring of tea in a cup

explanation.walkthrough: 'Creating a stir' suggests causing a commotion, perhaps in a football cup tie; here it is a small utensil literally stirring a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A small spoon is used to stir sugar or milk into tea in a cup.

clue.text: Prehistoric monument seen on the ground, inspiring gasps initially

indicators.note: inspiring means breathing that letter in, so it goes inside the other letters
ground, as in ground down, says the letters are broken up and rearranged
initially picks the first letter of gasps

explanation.surface: An ancient monument viewed at ground level draws gasps from visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the ground' reads as location, but 'ground' is the anagram signal and 'on the' is fodder with 'seen'.
explanation.definitionFit: The stone circle on Salisbury Plain in Wiltshire is England's best-known prehistoric monument.

clue.text: Natural magic in a grotto, somewhat uplifting

indicators.note: uplifting says the hidden letters are read backwards
somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A cave with a magical atmosphere is a natural, rather uplifting place.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'uplifting' turns CINAGRO, the hidden run, upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Food or produce grown without artificial chemicals is described as natural.

clue.text: Nation that was controlled by me

parts.note: I is the speaker, me
something that was controlled by me is something I ran

explanation.surface: A former dictator boasts of a country he once ruled.
explanation.definitionFit: The Islamic Republic in western Asia, formerly Persia, is a nation.

clue.text: Drink studied, moan out loud

indicators.note: out loud says the words are spoken and the sounds give the answer

parts.note: read, past tense of studied and said 'red', followed by whine, a moan

explanation.surface: Someone drinking while studying lets out a loud groan.
explanation.definitionFit: Wine made from dark grapes, such as claret or merlot, is a drink.

clue.text: Two fathers requiring a temple

parts.note: pa is a father, and God is the Father

explanation.surface: Two priests need a place of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiered tower in Buddhist East Asia is a kind of temple.

clue.text: Eat in drinking establishment

indicators.note: in says the letters are found within the following words

explanation.surface: A suggestion to have a meal at the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drinking establishment' looks like a pub, but the letters run across the end of drinking into the start of establishment.
explanation.definitionFit: To take food into the body by swallowing is to consume it.

clue.text: I blacken the name of Briton, say

parts.note: taken as written
to slander is to blacken someone's name

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to badmouthing a British person.
explanation.definitionFit: A Briton lives on an island, so is an example of someone from an island.

clue.text: Leads in Ibsen dramas often lacking for film star

indicators.note: Leads in picks the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Lead roles in Ibsen plays are often short of a movie celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: A screen celebrity adored by fans is a hero or icon to them.

clue.text: Aged, not decrepit, did a dance

indicators.note: decrepit means worn out and broken down, so the letters are knocked into a new shape

explanation.surface: An old person, not yet frail, took to the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: To have performed the Argentine ballroom dance is to have danced.

clue.text: A pressing household chore?

parts.note: pressing seems to mean urgent, but it is pressing clothes flat with a hot appliance

explanation.walkthrough: 'Pressing' suggests an urgent job; the chore literally presses laundry.
explanation.definitionFit: Smoothing creases out of laundry with a hot appliance is a routine domestic task.

clue.text: Light box to carry on banner

indicators.note: to carry says the box holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a crate is a wooden box for carrying goods
taken as written
a flag is a banner

explanation.surface: A boxer is told to keep going despite the flag being raised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light box' reads as a lamp housing, but 'Light' is a verb and the box is a crate.
explanation.definitionFit: To set something ablaze, to cause it to burn, is to light it.
